_about: WORDS THREE, HIS HOMEWORK, SHEET FOUR: THE MOMENTS NO CARD HAS ASKED (VAMILY rules 465, 454(c), 455; ask rows 629, 637). Rule 465 (Paolo 11/20: 'im still not done with the replacement text vibes from the voting shit'): he is answering card by card, so the sheets must never run out; this one waits BEHIND sheet three. Forty cards asked mouths; these twelve ask MOMENTS none of them reached: a kid's first kill, being shot at, machines, the client paying, a man laid up, his second teaching, a kid he said no to, a post about a boss, the smiling man with the tape, a dying woman, a woman running for her life, and a card where nobody talks at all. tools/bohemia_words_two_homework.js reads every line out of the named file; nothing here is a line. No rewrite of ours rides on any card. Nothing he writes on a card goes into the game until he says he is done (rule 465).
said: you show me one sentence or one dialog caption that you made and then I'll tell you how I want that shit to sound

cards.when: his shot kills a man and the man does not get up
cards.where: in a FIGHT, over his head
cards.teaches: A KILL: the first card on the moment somebody of yours kills a man; a kid who thought it was the movies; is it scary, and does he swear

cards.who: YOUR MAN, THE ONE WHO COUNTS
cards.who_plain: The one in your crew who keeps count of everybody
cards.when: it is the enemy's turn and they are about to shoot
cards.where: in a FIGHT, over his head
cards.teaches: BEING SHOT AT: the moment the other side moves and you can only wait; is it an order, a prayer, or a scream

cards.when: a fight opens against a pack of old robots with somebody running them
cards.where: in a FIGHT, over his head
cards.teaches: MACHINES: the only enemy that is not a person or an animal; how scared are people of a robot somebody brought back

cards.role: the person who posted the job, paying
cards.who_plain: The person who posted the job you just did
cards.when: you come back with the job done and the pay is counted out
cards.where: on the MAP, on the small face plate when a job pays
cards.teaches: THE MONEY CHANGES HANDS: every job ends here and no card has asked it; does somebody who paid for killing say thank you, and is it scary

cards.who_plain: One of your men, badly hurt in the fight
cards.when: the fight is over and he cannot fight for weeks
cards.where: on the MAP, on the small face plate after a fight
cards.teaches: A MAN HURT FOR A MONTH (your 9/27 rule: struck down is a debilitating injury of 30 to 40 days): is he scared, angry, joking; and is the number of days his to say

cards.role: the man who walks beside you
cards.who_plain: Your second, the man who walks beside you
cards.when: a job shows on your phone and you have not taken one yet
cards.where: on the MAP, on the small face plate
cards.teaches: THE TEACHING VOICE: the game showing you how to play through a man's mouth; can a lesson be scary first, and does it open in Spanish

cards.mouth: THE KID YOU SAID NO TO
cards.who_plain: A kid whose street's water was shut off
cards.when: he asked you to go after the boss who shut the water off, and you said 'Not my problem.'
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card that starts a boss's trail
cards.teaches: AFTER YOU SAY NO: your own kid begged and offered work; this kid hears no; what does a desperate kid say to the armed men who walk away

cards.who_plain: An old woman locked out of her own house
cards.when: she posts about the boss who took every key in town
cards.teaches: A POST THAT WARNS: the feed teaching the valley about a boss and how he fights; an old woman typing, three sentences and a capital name

cards.who_plain: A smiling man in the road holding a TV that shows your crew from above
cards.when: he stops you on the road
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card that stops your crew on the road
cards.teaches: THE TAPE: the most analog-horror stranger we have, and a line that starts with what he does in brackets before a word is said; is a bracket allowed in a mouth, and is the smile scary

cards.mouth: A SIDE QUEST ON THE ROAD
cards.who_plain: An old woman dying in a chair at the side of the road
cards.when: you stop beside her and she asks one last thing of you
cards.where: on the MAP, on a side quest's first card
cards.teaches: A DYING WOMAN: the last thing somebody says; three breaths, forgiveness for the man who took her son; how long may the dying talk, and is she in hell

cards.who_plain: A woman running from a pump house with two jugs
cards.when: she runs up to your wagon with men coming after her
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card that stops your crew on the road
cards.teaches: RUNNING FOR HER LIFE: your law says nobody asks for free; she has seconds and offers nothing but 'please'; does a person this scared still name a deal, and does she cry out in Spanish

cards.mouth: A ROAD STOP WITH NOBODY TALKING
cards.who_plain: Nobody: a dead courier in a ditch and a crow on him
cards.when: you pass a body on the road
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card that stops your crew on the road
cards.teaches: A CARD WITH NOBODY TALKING: the whole line is a description in brackets, written by nobody; should the game ever describe a scene, or must every word come from a mouth (your 9/20 rule)
